visual.title: A limit asks what the two sides approach
visual.caption: Narrow the band around a. The hole at a does not matter, because the limit describes the approach rather than the value there.

predict.question: At a hole in a graph, the limit does what?
options: Can exist even though the value there does not
predict.explain: The limit describes what the two sides approach, and a single missing point does not disturb that approach.
